title: ¿De dónde eres?
blurbEn: Ana's friends come from three different countries. This text introduces the subject pronouns and the word 'the'.
body:
Yo soy de España. Mi amigo Pablo es de México. Él vive en una ciudad muy grande.

Mi amiga Sofía es de Argentina. Ella es estudiante.

Nosotros somos amigos, pero no vivimos en el mismo país.

¿Y tú? ¿De dónde eres?
translationEn:
I am from Spain. My friend Pablo is from Mexico. He lives in a very big city.

My friend Sofía is from Argentina. She is a student.

We are friends, but we do not live in the same country.

And you? Where are you from?

amiga.note: Same word as 'amigo', ending in -a because Sofía is female.

phrases.note: 'ser' + 'de' is how you give where someone is from.
To make a sentence negative, put 'no' straight before the verb. Nothing else changes.
